Android Intent handlers

Observe Android intents and optionally handle them before the app.

Registration

Use IntentsManager.new_global_before_handler(callback, **filters) or new_global_after_handler. The returned handle can be closed. A before-handler can return True to consume an intent.

Match the action

Use scheme, host, path, action, MIME type, categories and flag filters. Without an explicit action, the handler targets ACTION_VIEW links. BYgram dispatches callbacks after account access and lock-screen checks.
